variants.title: Coves not kingdoms
variants.premise: The boatman is bailing seawater out of his little boat at the far end of the pier.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Any chance of a lift out of Varlamore?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Out? I go along the coast, iknami. Not out.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: What's the difference?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The difference is who's waiting at the other end.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I know the coves. That's all.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Wine.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Just wine?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Wine's what's written on them.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Money's the easy part.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Getting stopped is the expensive part.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Someone in the capital, I hear. Never asked.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: My boat's never been in a book. Keeping it that way.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Mind the ropes on your way back up.

variants.title: Tide's out
variants.premise: The boatman sits on a wine crate at the pier's end, watching the water pull off the rocks.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Could you row me past the kingdom's waters?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Nilsal. No.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: That was quick.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Not on this tide. Not on any.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Coast work only. I like my boat unburnt.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Bandits, mostly. They watch the coves too.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Very thorough men.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Somebody always knows.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: That's how I eat, most weeks.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Half of them wave me through the cove at dusk.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: And the other half?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The other half I go round.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Mind the stone dust. Gets in everything down here.

variants.title: Name in a book
variants.premise: The boatman is shoving crates under a tarpaulin, and stops dead when he sees the quiver.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: I still need a ship out of Varlamore.

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: The boatman drops the tarpaulin and looks up.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Tetamo. That's a Colosseum quiver.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: It is.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Then you don't want me. You want the capital.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Harbour registrar, up at the Cothon. He keeps the ledger.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Because your name goes in a book now.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Mine never has. Let's keep us both happy.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Big harbour in Civitas illa Fortis. You can't miss it.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Ask for the registrar. He'll be the bored one.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I've not set foot in that city in nine years.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Too many people there remember faces.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Timoiva.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Don't tell him where you heard it.
